description: Schematic tier: 12 harvested boards with a usable schematic (harvest_schematics.py), each imported from its schematic with import-kicad-netlist, given the task list's constraints (moved onto the new footprints by schematic.py), laid out at a third of the work budget and checked with drc-kicad-board. Chosen for mixed size (8 two-layer, 2 four-layer, 2 six-layer; 25 to 443 parts) and for what each exercises in the import (why). Per board: layers, sheets, parts on the designer's board and from the import, board-only parts, footprints missing before the libraries were added, the v16 layout sweep's full-budget seconds and work, and seconds (the expected time at a third of the budget, which orders the runner) and peak_rss_mb (the memory gate) from the tier's first run. README.md, 'The schematic tier'.

bitshiftcrazy__spell_tome__spell_tome_bo.why: the smallest: one sheet, its libraries in the project; short tier

duckyb__urchin__main.why: a split keyboard from a KiCad 6 schematic and libraries; 42 board-only holes and logos copied; short tier

CDFER__Business-Cards__USB_Keypad.why: 17 board-only parts (connector shells, holes); short tier, routing left open there

0xCB-dev__0xCB-Static__0xcb-static.why: 43 footprints missing until the library the designer kept outside the project is added (the agent's import-again step)

sporkus__le_chiffre_keyboard_stm32__stm3.why: 11 footprints found under KiCad 9's names or in other libraries (substituted)

tubbytwins__bumwings-kbd__bumwings_v001R.why: 12 references the board renamed after the schematic: matched by symbol path

headblockhead__slab-pcb__slab-pcb-left.why: a keyboard half with one symbol pin the footprint lacks

baldengineer__bit-preserve__coco2.why: 16 footprints from a KiCad 5 library (module): x1002 does not place them

OpenDrone-hw__OpenFC-Lite__OpenFC.why: 6 layers, a flight controller; short tier

tengigabytes__MokyaLora__MokyaLora.why: 6 layers, the largest complete import (443 parts)

Spaceflight-Rocketry-Giessen-e-V__Teleme.why: 4 layers, a rocket telemetry board; replaces laptop power, whose ESP32-S2-MINI-1 is 45.4 x 35.25 mm in KiCad 10's library (15.9 x 21 mm on the designer's board) and leaves no room on a 64 x 45 mm board
